messages:
Ivy: dropping a quick thread on a couple of things I hit while testing keys on mobile and with keyboard-only. Also a bulk-revoke/rotate ask from support. Can folks weigh in?

Noor (PM): thanks. TLDR: 1) bulk actions UX (select multiple keys -> rotate/revoke) 2) audit log wording for rotate events 3) mobile/compact layout for key detail.

Marcus (Design): bulk actions: show checkbox row, then an inline contextual bar with primary action 'Rotate selected' and a red 'Revoke selected' secondary. Need to be careful with destructive affordances—maybe require a confirmation modal for bulk revoke with a typed acknowledgement if >5 keys.

Zoe (A11y): bulk revoke typed confirm for >5 keys is fine but ensure it's keyboard friendly. For the confirmation dialog: focus the text input, label it 'Type REVOKE to confirm' and add aria-invalid on mistakes. Also include aria-live on the count so SR users know how many keys are selected.

Ivy: nice. support also asked to add an audit log sentence when rotation happens: currently our event says 'key rotated'  want to include whether overlap was enabled and the expiry time. e.g., 'key rotated; overlap enabled until 2026-03-25T14:32Z' so ops can quickly scan. Thoughts on wording?

Noor (PM): include overlap state in the audit event. Wording proposal: 'API key rotated by [user] (overlap: 30m until 2026-03-25 14:32 UTC)'. Keep it short and parseable. Also store metadata fields separately for machine parsing.

Marcus (Design): audit log UI: show a compact badge 'overlap: 30m' with tooltip on hover explaining what that means. In the event list, show the end time in local timezone.

Zoe (A11y): Tooltip must be accessible (role=tooltip) and reachable by keyboard. Audit events should be readable lines not relying on color. For screen reader consumption, the tooltip's content should be read when focused.

Ivy: mobile: key detail screen is pretty tall. On small screens we should collapse scope pills into a single 'Scopes (3)' row that expands. Also move danger/revoke zone behind an accordion labeled 'Danger zone' to avoid accidental taps.

Marcus (Design): agree. Danger accordion should be collapsed by default on mobile but visible on desktop as a bottom panel. Keep the primary rotate/copy actions above the fold.

Noor (PM): one more: bulk-rotate semantics: when rotating multiple keys at once, do we generate distinct new secrets per key (yes) and do we offer an overlap toggle per-key or a global option? Support asked for per-key because some keys are critical.

Ivy: implementation note: backend already supports per-key overlap metadata. UX: in the bulk rotate modal, show a compact list with each key name and a small selector for overlap (on/off) per row; default all off. Add a 'Enable overlap for all' toggle at the top for convenience.

Zoe (A11y): ensure the per-row toggles are labeled with the key name in the accessible name (e.g., 'Enable overlap for payments-service-prod toggle'). Also warn about security tradeoffs in the modal with aria-describedby.

Marcus (Design): for bulk revoke: if >5 keys selected show the typed confirm and an inline summary: 'You are revoking 7 keys; 3 of these keys are used by services with active traffic.' Could surface a link to a small 'Impact' panel that lists last-used timestamps.

Ivy: good. final ask from support: add an 'export selected keys metadata' action in the bulk bar so SREs can snapshot scopes/owner/email before rotating. Implementation?

Noor (PM): add 'Export .csv' icon in the bulk bar. It should include key id, name, scopes, owner, last_used_at, overlap_until if any. Make sure export respects permissions.

Zoe (A11y): exported CSV column headers must be human-readable. Also ensure the export button is operable with keyboard and announces 'Export ready' via role=alert when file is generated.

infra-bot: Note: staging now has a feature-flag 'bulk-keys' enabled for the team. Please test flows.

deploy-bot: Scheduled staging deploy 2026-03-24T17:00Z  includes bulk-keys feature flag and keys UI polish.

Ivy: thanks all  i'll sketch the bulk modal and mobile accordion and post Figma link. Tagging Zoe for a11y pass when done. :raised_hands:
